CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to contents found.

COD.rationale: Content (red set), its organization/origin metadata, and the separation of content vs origin are all explicitly present for p0/current/n0.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to the same content's organization/presentation/access was stated.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify referents with named attributes (red/blue) and coordinate sets.

D.rationale: Content values (red set) are recorded separately from origin/status metadata for the same referent, showing a distinction between identity and status/organization.

O.rationale: The report explicitly states presentation/organization information (grid orientation) and origin/organization metadata for specific content entries (current and candidate).
